TOEFL:
As an ETS-trained TOEFL coach and CELTA-certified teacher, I’ve developed proven strategies to help you succeed.

Learn how to effectively skim and scan academic passages, master time management, and confidently tackle university-level reading tasks. 

Let’s work together to build your confidence and get the score you need to achieve your goals in one try!

I will listen without judgement and offer a lot of empathy. I will let you speak. I will give you the opportunity to really be heard.

Instead, I like to hear what people really think, what they have experienced in their lives, and what they care about.
